column5: GROUP: terminal-runtime (032): | - `TR/clock.rs:405-409,422`: Poll ignores its pointer argument; "a poll with a nonzero pointer and zero count is treated as a pure sleep". Not traced whether the pointer is validated elsewhere.

GROUP: terminal-runtime (032): | - `TR/filesystem.rs:437-439`: `admit_services` checks only additional services and skips the owning service, while `supplied` is true for any `HostNamespace` delegation. No wrong program named.

GROUP: build-declarations and build-output (032): | - `BD/dependencies/mod.rs:162`: dependency calls nested in other states or helpers are not seen by `project_dependency_rows`; "open for this crate". See Disagreements 6: the package-manager caller rejects them.

GROUP: build-declarations and build-output (032): | - `BO/captured_source/mod.rs:68-75,159`: `matches_row_kind` ignores `digest` and the enum fields are public, so an entry whose digest does not match its bytes would be accepted; not traced whether any caller builds variants directly.

GROUP: build-declarations and build-output (032): | - `BO/staged_output_tree.rs:136-176`: `from_retained_parts` accepts a tree with a missing parent directory or a symlink target that escapes the root, if the commitment matches; the only non-test caller is `PC/build_execution/build_record_codec.rs:233`.

GROUP: package-compilation (032, 033): | - `PC/build_execution/build_admission.rs:78-81`: no reach-plan row for the build machine means empty reach, so it is admitted as `Pure` with no restrictions; plan construction not read.

GROUP: package-compilation (032, 033): | - `PC/build_execution/build_record_codec.rs` (observation at end of its entry): decoded `RestrictedBuildRequest` and `BuildObservationSummary` are rebuilt without re-running admission; whether the cache key binds them is "open".
GROUP: package-compilation (032, 033): | - `PC/build_execution/filesystem_scope.rs:91,99-101`: `overlap_key` falls back to a lexical or raw path, so "an odd path then compares by spelling only".
